reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Explicit links and exact project names route requests; evaluated semantic/history-based disambiguation is not implemented.

features.name: Compatible request grouping without lost identities
features.remaining: One-level grouping preserves child criteria and parent amendments; ambiguous legacy ownership blocks changes. Automatic semantic grouping remains out of scope.

features.name: Multiple deliverables tracked separately
features.remaining: Separate deliverables can be reviewed and exported without premature request completion; interpretation and semantic acceptance still require review.

features.name: New projects and historical reopening
features.remaining: Reopen preserves criteria and historical lineage; actual customized-user data migration remains target-qualified separately.

features.name: Explainable/correctable routing and bounded clarification
features.remaining: Explicit choices and unresolved-project states are inspectable/correctable; richer clarification and semantic routing remain unevaluated.

features.name: Ordered amendments and retry identity
features.remaining: Revision checks, idempotent retries and concurrent grouped amendments are covered; live worker response to changes remains separate.

features.name: Durable project portfolio and priorities
features.remaining: Project priorities, pauses and filtered views exist; live portfolio load and fairness qualification remain.

features.name: Scoped cross-project dependencies
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Read grants and host workspace mappings exist; cross-project execution dependencies and hostile-worker isolation require stronger boundaries.

features.name: Versioned requirements and canonical plans
features.remaining: Saved criteria/plans survive revisions and preflight rejects stale or malformed scope; semantic completeness of plans remains a review task.

features.name: Fair scheduling and interactive capacity
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Priority aging/pause and Temporal host interactive reserves are implemented; cross-backend fairness, live contention and large-fleet load remain.

features.name: Recoverable peer agent identities
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Managed Paperclip identities and Temporal workflow/process receipts preserve ownership; authenticated agent restart/reconciliation needs live qualification.

features.name: Role/team templates
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Bounded templates and qualified profile selection are wired; live task quality and role suitability are not established by fixtures.

features.name: Peer versus child ownership and limits
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Parent/dependency validation and child-depth limits exist; distinct native child-versus-peer semantics need coordinator/harness conformance evidence.

features.name: Durable agent communication with receipts
features.remaining: Durable messages and ordered receipts are tested; actual peer conversation, backpressure and useful collaboration remain live gates.

features.name: Independent review and bounded repair
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Independent outcome labels, separate deliverable acceptance and competing-review protection exist; authenticated independence and useful repair loops remain.

features.name: Harness/model/effort capability profiles
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Exact assistant canary/completion and failed-reprobe invalidation are tested; actual provider/model/effort and both auth modes need target evidence.

features.name: Captured permitted conversation history
features.remaining: Actual LCM capture, scoped recall and project-local Codex hook-file merge passed with synthetic messages. Live harness hook activation and complete permitted cross-session capture remain unqualified.

features.name: Original source archive and anchors
features.remaining: Original and extracted-text hashes are checked; broader formats, source anchors and corpus-specific extraction fidelity remain.

features.name: Expandable summaries linked to originals
features.remaining: Explicit LCM summary/expansion calls validate provider, project and original links; disabled/no-work responses stay not_generated. Provider-generated summary fidelity and repeated real context windows remain unqualified.

features.name: QMD exact/semantic scoped retrieval
features.remaining: Actual QMD 2.8.3 CPU embedding/vector retrieval and project isolation passed on a small synthetic corpus. Hybrid reranking and production retrieval quality remain unqualified; the pinned source-build lock mismatch still requires manual review.

features.name: Whole-corpus coverage accounting
features.remaining: Inventory/extraction/review accounting is explicit; very large corpus orchestration and proof of complete understanding remain open.

features.name: Facts, decisions, contradictions and supersession
features.remaining: Dated assertions, contradictions and supersession remain inspectable; automatic contradiction discovery and truth assessment remain open.

features.name: Bounded current-context assembly
features.remaining: Bounded source packets expose omissions; tokenizer-specific limits and evaluated relevance over large contexts remain.

features.name: Export, invalidation, retention and deletion
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Local invalidation/purge and managed Hindsight/OpenViking deletion/reconciliation are implemented; other external indices, backups and automatic retention remain.

features.name: One replaceable runtime backend
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Paperclip default and optional Temporal are exclusively selected and fenced; live backend conformance and production cutover remain.

features.name: Real readiness and capability health
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Doctor, coordinator health, worker pollers, profile probes and observations are distinct; no single check certifies full readiness.

features.name: Detached parallel execution
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Paperclip issue DAGs and Temporal parallel activities are wired; authenticated detached model runs and production restarts remain.

features.name: Ralph-style fresh-context continuation
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Both backends implement explicit checkpoint/stop/fresh-generation handoff; five genuine fresh-model sessions and hard context-limit recovery remain unqualified.

features.name: Bounded iteration and no-progress detection
features.remaining: Iteration/time and repeated-artifact checks are enforced; semantic no-progress detection and real-model budget behavior remain separate.

features.name: Crash and uncertain-effect reconciliation
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Durable receipts and uncertain leases block blind replay; OS crash, network partitions and external-effect reconciliation need target/soak evidence.

features.name: Scoped pause/cancel including shared work
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Grouped withdrawal, new-dispatch pause and scoped cancellation are wired; cancellation status alone does not prove every process stopped.

features.name: Isolated workspaces and shared resource limits
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Private execution copies, local writer locks, fleet leases and bounded processes exist; distributed workspaces, OS isolation and global resource quotas remain.

features.name: Native WezTerm navigation
features.remaining: Native WezTerm has run in the cloud; the user desktop, configuration conflicts, shortcuts, reconnect, sleep and reboot still need qualification.

features.name: Persistent requests and obligation progress
features.remaining: Current-revision accepted/total criteria, scoped filters and amendments are tested; target desktop and live workload usability remain.

features.name: Dedicated Outcomes view
features.remaining: Persistent outcomes remain separate from logs and selected details survive refresh/log floods; user-desktop outcome-finding evaluation remains.

features.name: Versioned result cards, checks and limitations
features.remaining: Versioned cards distinguish planned/fixture/observed state, partial acceptance and evidence checks; semantic result quality remains reviewed.

features.name: Search, pin, read, reopen and export outcomes
features.remaining: Search before display limits, pin/read/reopen and immutable multi-deliverable exports are tested; target desktop acceptance remains.

features.name: Team/agent/child views and meaningful updates
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Team nodes and coordinator observations are shown without claiming plans are live agents; native child semantics and live collaboration usefulness remain.

features.name: Dependencies, reservations and usage visibility
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Dependency graphs, capacity/reserves and reported CLI token counters are visible; unknown/conflicting usage stays unknown. Live provider costs, subscription balance and CPU/memory telemetry remain.

features.name: Context health and attention inbox
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Context coverage, health/attention and stale diagnostics are visible; evaluated retrieval health and model context-pressure detection remain.

features.name: Diagrams, charts and artifact previews
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Plan DAG diagrams and safe HTML/Markdown/JSON exports exist; richer chart generation, artifact preview routing and broad visual inspection remain.

features.name: Safe, legible, recoverable diagnostics UI
features.remaining: Escaped diagnostics, malformed-state recovery, narrow layouts and log-flood selection are tested; native target-desktop conformance remains.

features.name: Superpowers evidence-led brainstorming
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Pinned Superpowers activation and missing-procedure blocking are wired; live brainstorming coverage, useful alternatives and artifact quality remain.

features.name: Readable plans and executable packets from one model
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Versioned plans feed bounded coordinator packets and human exports; evaluated plan completeness and human/agent understanding remain.

features.name: Versioned skill activation and resume checks
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Procedure paths/hashes, preflight integrity and resume requirement checks exist; live adherence and companion-file portability remain.

features.name: Audience and approved writing profile
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Configured audience and word budgets reach plans/outcome lint; approved writing preference retention and meaning-preserving editorial quality remain.

features.name: Writing Clearly and Concisely, Humanizer and Vale
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Named writing/Humanizer procedures and Vale execution are available; concision without lost meaning, factual quality and reader calibration remain.

features.name: Rendered, inspected visual documents
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Safe rendered exports and terminal captures exist; broader document formats, diagram/chart quality and human visual acceptance remain.

features.name: Python, TypeScript/JavaScript and Rust execution packs
features.remaining: Real Python, JavaScript, TypeScript and Rust process checks and failures are tested; target toolchains/dependencies and end-product behavior remain.

features.name: Evidence-based evaluation and human calibration
reasons: Implementation catalog still records incomplete integration
features.remaining: Per-feature evidence, source binding and calibration mechanisms exist; held-out live judges, semantic quality and human calibration remain.

features.name: Routing, selection and outcome-finding evaluation
